lines.zh: 温水海洋里，我们三四尾一起掠过珊瑚。
lines.en: Three or four of us skim the coral in one warm school.

lines.zh: 铜色的鳍一摆，像有人在水里划了根火柴。
lines.en: One flick of my copper fin strikes a match underwater.

lines.zh: 温水海洋是我的跑道，珊瑚是我的栏杆。
lines.en: The warm ocean is my track; the coral is my railing.

lines.zh: 我游得比火焰快，水却不让我烧起来。
lines.en: I swim faster than flame; the water won't let me burn.

lines.zh: 三四尾同游，铜光在礁石上连成一片。
lines.en: Four of us pass, and the reef glows copper together.

lines.zh: 别追我，我的尾巴会闪成一串火星。
lines.en: Don't chase me; my tail scatters a line of sparks.

lines.zh: 温水让我的鳞片一直亮着铜红。
lines.en: Warm water keeps my scales lit copper-red all day.

lines.zh: 我们贴着海草走，像一束游动的火。
lines.en: We slide past the seagrass like a wandering flame.

lines.zh: 铜色的背鳍划开海水，留下一道暖痕。
lines.en: My copper dorsal fin cuts a warm seam through the water.

lines.zh: 集体转向时，整群像被风掀起的火苗。
lines.en: When we all turn, the school flares like wind-tossed fire.

lines.zh: 我燃烧的只是颜色，不是温度。
lines.en: The fire in me is only color, never heat.

lines.zh: 三四尾并排，铜鳞把阳光折回海面。
lines.en: Four abreast, our copper scales throw sunlight back up.

lines.zh: 前面那尾一拐，我们全跟着拐。
lines.en: The lead fish turns, and the whole school turns with it.

lines.zh: 游过礁石时，我留下一瞬的铜色影子。
lines.en: Passing the reef, I leave one instant of copper shadow.

lines.zh: 我们绕着礁柱转半圈，再散开。
lines.en: We round the reef pillar halfway, then spread.

lines.zh: 铜光扫过沙面，像有人点了盏灯。
lines.en: Copper light sweeps the sand like a lit lamp.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，鳍慢慢扇，像余烬。
lines.en: I hang in the water, fins fanning like dying embers.

lines.zh: 铜色的鳞在温水里微微发亮。
lines.en: Copper scales glimmer faintly in the warm current.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，看起来像块烧红的铜。
lines.en: Holding still, I look like a piece of heated copper.

lines.zh: 三四尾挤在珊瑚影里打盹。
lines.en: Three or four of us doze in the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 温水海洋没有冬天，我也不用熄火。
lines.en: Warm oceans have no winter, so I never bank my fire.

lines.zh: 有鱼靠太近，我的鳍会先亮一下。
lines.en: If a fish comes close, my fins brighten first.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收拢，火苗就缩成一小簇。
lines.en: I fold my fins, and the flame shrinks to a spark.

lines.zh: 海草摆动，我跟着摆，懒得多游一步。
lines.en: The seagrass sways; I sway too, too lazy to swim.

lines.zh: 别拿网兜晃我，我只想悬在这里。
lines.en: Stop waving that net at me; I only want to hover here.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过温水，在我背上烙出一道金线。
lines.en: Sunlight through warm water brands a gold line on my back.

lines.zh: 我们这一小群，安静得像沉底的炭。
lines.en: Our little school sits quiet as sunken coals.

lines.zh: 偶尔摆尾，只为确认自己还亮着。
lines.en: I flick my tail now and then, just to stay lit.

lines.zh: 水里的我一直在烧，只是看不见火焰。
lines.en: I burn constantly underwater, though no flame shows.

lines.zh: 珊瑚上的光斑晃动，我也跟着晃。
lines.en: The light dapples on the coral; I drift along with it.

lines.zh: 你潜到这么暖的水里，是来找铜色吗。
lines.en: You dove into water this warm; are you hunting copper?

lines.zh: 隔着护目镜，我看见你的眼睛也在发光。
lines.en: Through your goggles I see your eyes shining too.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的鳍会烫到你的手。
lines.en: Not so close; my fins would scald your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里没有骨粉吧？我就问问。
lines.en: You don't have bone meal there, do you? Just asking.

lines.zh: 我们三四尾一起转头看你。
lines.en: All three of us turn our heads to study you.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上，我以为又是条大鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow on the surface looked like another big fish.

lines.zh: 铜色的我盯着你的铜色装备，很像同类。
lines.en: My copper meets your copper armor; we almost match.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得比我这道火光更快。
lines.en: To catch me you must beat this streak of fire.

lines.zh: 你来温水海洋，是为了看一群会游的铜？
lines.en: Did you come to these warm seas for swimming copper?

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只怕网兜和冷掉的水。
lines.en: People don't scare me; nets and cooling water do.

lines.zh: 你这一刀把我铜色的鳞掀开了。
lines.en: That cut peels back my copper scales.

lines.zh: 温水里混进我的血，颜色变深了。
lines.en: My blood mixes into the warm water and darkens it.

lines.zh: 疼，可我的鳍还亮着。
lines.en: It hurts, but my fins are still lit.

lines.zh: 三四尾全散开了，只剩我在这。
lines.en: My three companions scattered; only I remain.

lines.zh: 别砍第二下，我掉的东西不值这个。
lines.en: Don't swing twice; what I drop isn't worth it.

lines.zh: 我往珊瑚缝里挤，鳞又掉了几片。
lines.en: I squeeze into the coral gap and lose more scales.

lines.zh: 铜色的血在水里散成一团火。
lines.en: Copper blood blooms in the water like fire.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起网兜的样子。
lines.en: This takes me back to the shape of a net.

lines.zh: 我还游得动，只是慢了一截。
lines.en: I can still swim, only a length slower.

lines.zh: 你会拿到骨粉和我那块生鱼肉。
lines.en: You'll get bone meal and that raw fillet of mine.

lines.zh: 水里有浮游的小虫，我就跟着走。
lines.en: If tiny drifting things cloud the water, I follow them.

lines.zh: 一团碎食撒下来，我这群就乱了队。
lines.en: A handful of crumbs falls, and my school breaks ranks.

lines.zh: 别用生鱼肉引我，那是我掉下来的那种。
lines.en: Don't lure me with raw fish; that's what I drop.

lines.zh: 温水里有食，我就把谨慎留在珊瑚后。
lines.en: With food in warm water, I leave caution at the coral.

lines.zh: 铜色的鳍张开了，这表示我感兴趣。
lines.en: My copper fins are spread; that means I'm interested.

lines.zh: 你撒骨粉做什么？那是我的掉落物。
lines.en: Why scatter bone meal? That's what I drop when killed.

lines.zh: 三四尾都挤过来，食物不够分。
lines.en: Three of us crowd in, and there is not enough.

lines.zh: 我追的是浮游物，不是你的手。
lines.en: I'm chasing drifting specks, not your fingers.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就以为开饭了。
lines.en: The water stirs, and I assume it's feeding time.

lines.zh: 喂我可以，别把我装进桶里带走。
lines.en: Feed me if you like, but don't bucket me away.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的铜鳞响了一声。
lines.en: You bump me, and my copper scales ring once.

lines.zh: 这股水波把我的队形冲散了。
lines.en: That wave of yours scattered my neat formation.

lines.zh: 别推，三四尾一挤就全乱了。
lines.en: Don't shove; three of us crowd and all order goes.

lines.zh: 铜色的鳍刮过你的靴子，有点烫吧。
lines.en: My copper fins scraped your boot; warm, wasn't it?

lines.zh: 我从你腿边掠过，不是故意撞你。
lines.en: I skimmed past your leg; I didn't mean to hit.

lines.zh: 水下看不清，撞礁石比撞你还疼。
lines.en: Underwater I see poorly; reef hurts worse than you.

lines.zh: 你挡在珊瑚口，我这群过不去。
lines.en: You block the coral gap, and my school can't pass.

lines.zh: 水流被你搅乱，我差点翻过去。
lines.en: You churned the current; I nearly flipped over.

lines.zh: 轻轻一碰，我的鳞片就掉了几片光。
lines.en: A light bump and a few flakes of shine fall off.

lines.zh: 让让，我身后还有三尾要过。
lines.en: Move aside; three more fish are coming behind me.

lines.zh: 温水海洋里，我找一尾同样发亮的。
lines.en: In warm seas I seek a fish shining the same.

lines.zh: 两尾并游，铜光叠成更亮的一线。
lines.en: Two of us swim abreast, copper brightening into one line.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚转圈，这是给同类的信号。
lines.en: I circle the coral; this signal is meant for my kind.

lines.zh: 三四尾里，我只追鳍最红的那一尾。
lines.en: Of the four, I chase only the reddest-finned one.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在珊瑚影里成对。
lines.en: Don't interrupt; we pair off in the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞片碰在一起，声音很轻。
lines.en: Our scales touch, and the sound is very soft.

lines.zh: 等水温再暖一点，你就跟着我游。
lines.en: When the water warms a little more, follow me.

lines.zh: 铜火要传下去，得先找到对的那尾。
lines.en: Copper fire must pass on, so I find the right mate.

lines.zh: 我转了三圈，她才跟我并排。
lines.en: I circled three times before she swam beside me.

lines.zh: 同类之间，火光认火光。
lines.en: Among our kind, one flame recognizes another.

lines.zh: 你把我捞起来，鳞片还在发烫。
lines.en: You scoop me up, and my scales are still hot.

lines.zh: 桶里的水是凉的，我的铜色暗下去。
lines.en: The bucket water is cold; my copper dims.

lines.zh: 离开温水海洋，我连鳍都张不开。
lines.en: Out of warm seas, I can't even spread my fins.

lines.zh: 我掉骨粉，是因为鳞上那层粉。
lines.en: I drop bone meal; it's the dust on my scales.

lines.zh: 轻点捏，我的鳍比纸还薄。
lines.en: Hold me gently; my fins are thinner than paper.

lines.zh: 你会把我放回珊瑚那边吗？
lines.en: Will you put me back by the coral?

lines.zh: 淡水会要我的命，桶里也是淡水。
lines.en: Fresh water kills me, and that bucket holds fresh water.

lines.zh: 我在这只手里烧不起来，很闷。
lines.en: I can't burn in this hand, and it feels stifling.

lines.zh: 别把我扔在沙上，我连翻身都难。
lines.en: Don't toss me on the sand; I can barely turn over.

lines.zh: 三四尾挤一只桶，水很快就浑了。
lines.en: Four of us in one bucket and the water clouds fast.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在动，我那点铜光藏不住。
lines.en: Something moves in the water, and my copper can't hide.

lines.zh: 我盯住那道影子，先往珊瑚后缩。
lines.en: I fix on that shadow and first shrink behind the coral.

lines.zh: 是鱼还是人？我的鳍已经竖起来了。
lines.en: Fish or person? My fins are already standing up.

lines.zh: 三四尾同时散开，这是我们的警报。
lines.en: All four of us scatter; that's our alarm signal.

lines.zh: 它比礁石大，我不敢往前游。
lines.en: It's bigger than the reef; I won't swim forward.

lines.zh: 我认出那个影子，是常来捕鱼的人。
lines.en: I know that silhouette; it's the usual fisherman.

lines.zh: 我这群跟着我一起退了半身位。
lines.en: My whole school backs off half a body length with me.

lines.zh: 铜色在深水里太显眼，我该换到暗处。
lines.en: Copper stands out in deep water; I should move to shade.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看清你手里拿的是什么。
lines.en: Stay still and let me see what's in your hands.

lines.zh: 我盯得越久，越确定该逃。
lines.en: The longer I stare, the surer I am to flee.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚打圈，不想被追上。
lines.en: I circle the coral, not wanting to be caught.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就把鳍贴紧身子。
lines.en: One raise of your hand and my fins clamp down.

lines.zh: 我不反击，只会往更深的地方钻。
lines.en: I don't fight back; I only dive deeper down.

lines.zh: 快跑，三尾都跟着我拐了。
lines.en: Run; all three of them turned when I did.

lines.zh: 铜色的尾巴一闪，是给你的最后警告。
lines.en: My copper tail flashes once, a last warning to you.

lines.zh: 你追我，我追温水，看谁先累。
lines.en: You chase me, I chase warm water; let's see.

lines.zh: 我把队形收窄，好从石缝里穿过去。
lines.en: I tighten the formation so we can slip through stone.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子一直跟着，我不敢上浮。
lines.en: That shadow on the surface follows, so I stay deep.

lines.zh: 别把网放下来，我看得见。
lines.en: Don't lower that net; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我们再绕一圈，就能甩开你了。
lines.en: One more loop and we'll have shaken you off.

lines.zh: 我用鳍抽你的手背，铜的，很烫。
lines.en: I slap your hand with a copper fin, and it burns.

lines.zh: 别伸进来，我咬人也只有一口。
lines.en: Don't reach in; I bite, but only once.

lines.zh: 我撞你的手套，火光擦出一声脆响。
lines.en: I ram your glove and fire rings out sharp.

lines.zh: 三四尾一起撞，也敌不过你一只手。
lines.en: Four of us ramming still lose to one of your hands.

lines.zh: 我只会这一招：烧红的鳍扫过去。
lines.en: I have one move: a sweep of red-hot fin.

lines.zh: 你抓我，我就往你指缝里钻。
lines.en: Grab me and I'll slip between your fingers.

lines.zh: 铜色不是装饰，是用来划人的。
lines.en: The copper isn't decoration; it's for cutting.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你会记住这水温。
lines.en: That wasn't heavy, but you'll remember this water's heat.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我不会乖乖进桶。
lines.en: I can't beat you, but I won't enter that bucket.

lines.zh: 退后，我的鳍正对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: Back off; my fin is pointed at your eye.

lines.zh: 温水海洋分给我一小片珊瑚，我就在那住下。
lines.en: Warm seas gave me a patch of coral to live in.

lines.zh: 三四尾一起落进水里，我们生来就结群。
lines.en: Four of us drop in together; we school from birth.

lines.zh: 我从暖流里冒出来，鳍先亮，眼后睁。
lines.en: I surface from the warm current, fins bright first.

lines.zh: 这片海的温度刚好，我不用往深处躲。
lines.en: This sea is just warm enough; I needn't hide deeper.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一落地，铜色的光就散开。
lines.en: The spawn egg lands and copper light spreads through water.

lines.zh: 我一出生就带着火色，却从没烧过东西。
lines.en: I'm born flame-colored and have never burned a thing.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝是我的床，暖水是我的被子。
lines.en: Coral gaps are my bed, warm water my blanket.

lines.zh: 别把我放在冷水里，我会一直发抖。
lines.en: Don't set me in cold water; I'd shiver the whole time.

lines.zh: 这海里已经有三尾了，我是第四尾。
lines.en: Three fish already live here; I make the fourth.

lines.zh: 落水的一瞬，我就知道自己该往哪游。
lines.en: The moment I hit water, I know which way to swim.

lines.zh: 热水不是我的火，太烫了。
lines.en: This heat isn't my fire; it's far too hot.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下来，鳞都翻白了。
lines.en: I fall from the surface and my scales go pale.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会闷，别把我摁住。
lines.en: Even in water I can choke; don't hold me under.

lines.zh: 冲击把我这一群都吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows my whole school apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，铜色上多了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow goes through, leaving a hole in my copper.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我的火色暗了一半。
lines.en: That potion smell dims half my fire color.

lines.zh: 温水里没吃的，我的铜色开始发灰。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the warm water; my copper turns grey.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的鳍全立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and every fin of mine stands.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的火终于灭了。
lines.en: There's no water here, and my fire finally goes out.
